title: VRR Gamma Flicker on OLED Displays with Frame Generation
root_cause: VRR (Variable Refresh Rate) combined with frame generation causes irregular frame pacing. OLED displays with near-instantaneous response times show gamma instability when frame times vary. Frame generation produces alternating frame times (real/generated/real/generated).
resolution_type: Frame pacing smoothing. Generated frames timestamped to maintain consistent display intervals. VRR range clamping when frame generation active.
